biotools.summary: MicroMap is a network visualization resource for human microbiome metabolism, capturing over a quarter million microbial genome-scale metabolic reconstructions. It allows users to explore microbiome metabolism, inspect metabolic capabilities, and visualize computational modelling results, and integrates with the Virtual Metabolic Human and COBRA Toolbox.
